This transcription was made by the International Greek New Testament Project in its work towards the Editio Critica Maior of John between 2000 and 2010.

The initial transcription file was a plain text file for use with COLLATE, later converted to XML. Further information about the transcription procedures followed may be found in the electronic edition of the majuscules at

The plain text file was converted to XML by Catherine Smith using the project's Python conversion scripts 1.0.

The XML specifications used are version 1.6 of the IGNTP Guidelines available at

Correction tags changed at 5.19, 6.53, 8.12, 9.6, 23, 10.18 (and correction changed), 11.7 (and correction changed), 18, 19.9, 21.17 (and correction changed), by David Parker. Block markers changed in 6.54-6 by David Parker. Word breaks in 7.45, 8.43, 46, 12.5, 13.37, 21.11 corrected by David Parker. κε tagged as num at 6.19 by David Parker. Adjusted to XML specifications 1.6 by Hugh Houghton. Converted from plain text by Catherine Smith using Python conversion scripts 1.0 with manual adjustments.
